literal_meaning: পানিতে হাবুডুবু করে ডুবতে থাকা বা জল গিলে কষ্ট পাওয়া (onomatopoeic for splashing and struggling in water)
figurative_meaning_en: To be distressed or struggling in a crisis
example_sentences_in_bangla: অর্থনৈতিক মন্দায় তার ব্যবসা হাবুডুবু খাচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His business is struggling in the economic downturn.
The student is distressed under exam pressure.
history: The idiom originates from the onomatopoeic sound of splashing in water, evoking the image of someone floundering and nearly drowning, metaphorically applied to any dire situation.
note: The idiom vividly captures the panic of submersion, common in Bengali expressive language.
